children: Overview
China real estate services firm's interim revenue fell sharply yr/yr amid market weakness
Company swings to HY net profit, driven by gains from VIE arrangement terminations
Group continued cost control, debt restructuring and launched AI-driven DeepLink platform
Outlook
Company plans tighter integration of CRIC and DeepLink for AI-driven growth strategy
Result Drivers
MARKET WEAKNESS - Co said revenue fell sharply due to continued weakness in China's real estate market
VIE TERMINATION GAINS - Net profit was driven largely by gains from the termination of certain VIE arrangements
COST CONTROL & DEBT RESTRUCTURING - Group continued cost control and achieved milestone in offshore debt restructuring
